scientific_question: Can decentralized UAV policies use locally defensible agreement uncertainty to time commitment under delayed, lost, or stale plan acknowledgements?
one_sentence_thesis: Epistemic commitment control separates agreement uncertainty from physical control and uses risk-constrained Bayesian option value to choose when to commit, wait for information, or degrade gracefully.

not_claimed: first policy that waits for messages
candidate_differentiator: Bayesian option value for defer versus graceful fallback
closed-loop heterogeneous UAV coordination under private acknowledgement mismatch
targeted_prior_art_checked: robust and ambiguity-set POMDP decision making

full_method.name: epistemic_commitment_mappo
full_method.representation: local plan-consistency hypothesis set with posterior mass
full_method.decision_rule: maximize posterior expected option value among actions satisfying a frozen support-wise downside constraint
full_method.claim_scope: inductive bias, calibration, reliability, and sample efficiency

matched_controls: actor and critic capacity within declared tolerance

research_questions.RQ1: Does the full method improve fixed-endpoint task value over recurrent MAPPO?
research_questions.RQ2: Does it reduce unsupported commitment without replacing useful commitment by universal fallback?
research_questions.RQ3: Does explicit consistency representation add value beyond a point-belief gate?
research_questions.RQ4: Does the commitment gate add value beyond feeding the information set directly to a policy?
research_questions.RQ5: Does the learned behavior react to information-set shrinkage and acknowledgement arrival in the predicted direction?
research_questions.RQ6: What computation and decision-delay costs accompany the method?

endpoints.primary: per-seed mean task_value over the five frozen training-support evaluation cells
exploratory_only: performance on the two compositional heldout cells

statistics.pairing: same training seeds and evaluation tapes across all four cells
reporting: Holm correction across three frozen primary contrasts

staging.Q2: one-seed technical integration smoke for all four methods
staging.Q3: eight paired confirmatory seeds only after Q1 and Q2 pass
staging.formal_budget_rule: derive a fixed endpoint from blinded Q1 learning-curve maturity; do not inherit 10M by convention

interpretation_matrix.full_beats_baseline_but_not_ablations: task benefit supported; proposed mechanism decomposition unresolved
interpretation_matrix.set_only_matches_full: explicit representation may help; commitment gate necessity unsupported
interpretation_matrix.point_gate_matches_full: commitment control may help; set representation necessity unsupported
interpretation_matrix.all_methods_match: no empirical incremental value under the frozen task and budget
interpretation_matrix.task_value_rises_but_unsupported_commit_: performance-reliability tradeoff; no robustness or safety superiority claim
interpretation_matrix.full_improves_primary_and_both_module_co: full mechanism supported within the frozen task family
